Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps (legal -> security -> finance)

Hi Samantha — great call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock to a mutual timeline: 

- Summary: Demo covered hosted API, Dedicated pools, and private VPC options. Finexa emphasized SSO + retention controls and a firm PO process.
- Procurement path you mentioned: 
  1) Legal review (T&Cs / MSA)
  2) Security review (vendor questionnaire + pen-test reports)
  3) Finance approvals -> PO issuance
  4) Provisioning and pilot (2-week pilot / 30-day consumption window)

I've attached a first-pass mutual action plan (RWI-MAP-Finexa-v1.xlsx) that maps owners and proposed dates. Please review and highlight any changes. Two specific asks for your team: 
  - Can you confirm the legal reviewer and expected review SLAs? 
  - Is procurement comfortable issuing a PO or do you prefer a marketplace path (AWS Marketplace / Azure)?

Next steps from our side: Marissa will draft MSA redlines and Ben will pull the security package + SOC2/pen-test summary. I'll follow up with pricing hold details and marketplace notes by EOD Friday.

Attachments: RWI-MAP-Finexa-v1.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks,
Karthik

Thanks Karthik — appreciate the structured MAP. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Legal reviewer: that will be Alex (cc'd). Typical internal SLA is 7–10 business days for initial review, longer if our procurement ops needs commercial changes.
- Security: we complete a vendor questionnaire; I'll attach the form we use (Finexa-Vendor-Questionnaire.pdf). Our security lead will want SOC2 evidence and a summary of retention controls.
- Finance/procurement: we prefer PO for vendors >$50k. For smaller pilots, procurement sometimes accepts card. For enterprise rollouts, PO is standard.

Proposed timeline (subject to legal review): 
- 2026-12-22: Legal initial read + flag items
- 2027-01-05: Security questionnaire returned to you
- 2027-01-12: Finance completes approvals -> target PO issuance that week

We are open to marketplace on-ramps, but procurement will need to validate tax/invoicing before choosing that route. I'll introduce you to the procurement contact if/when legal indicates we can proceed.

Attachment: Finexa-Vendor-Questionnaire.pdf

Best,
Samantha Holt
